title: Demographic Encoding is Not Exposure: Fairness and Privacy in Chest X-ray Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.31014v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical foundation models encode patient demographics and can reveal whether a patient was in the training set, and these properties are often treated as one problem. We tested whether they are aligned by measuring demographic encoding, diagnostic fairness gaps and membership-inference vulnerability on the same models. We trained 200 linear or multilayer-perceptron (MLP) heads on frozen BiomedCLIP, DINOv2 and RAD-DINO embeddings, with three seeds, and audited them on CheXpert and NIH ChestX-ray14. Demographic encoding explained almost no variance in patient vulnerability, and all 72 CheXpert associations were statistically equivalent to zero. Erasing linearly decodable demographics left leakage unchanged but reduced age-related underdiagnosis gaps. Leakage depended instead on head capacity and training length. On RAD-DINO, a linear head reached a membership-inference area under the curve (AUC) of 0.694, compared with 0.907 for a 30-epo

translated_title: 人口统计学编码不等于暴露：胸部X光基础模型中的公平性与隐私性
translated_abstract: 医疗基础模型会编码患者的人口统计学信息，并且能够揭示某位患者是否在训练集中，这些特性通常被视为同一个问题。我们通过在相同模型上测量人口统计学编码、诊断公平性差距和成员推理攻击脆弱性，来检验二者是否一致。我们在冻结的 BiomedCLIP、DINOv2 和 RAD-DINO 嵌入上训练了200个线性或多层感知机（MLP）分类头，使用三个随机种子，并在 CheXpert 和 NIH ChestX-ray14 数据集上进行审计。结果表明，人口统计学编码几乎无法解释患者的隐私脆弱性差异，且全部72个 CheXpert 关联在统计上均等价于零。擦除线性可解码的人口统计学信息并未改变隐私泄漏情况，但减少了与年龄相关的漏诊差距。隐私泄漏反而取决于分类头的容量和训练时长。在 RAD-DINO 上，线性头的成员推理曲线下面积（AUC）达到0.694，而训练30轮的（模型达到0.907，摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现胸部X光基础模型中的人口统计学编码与隐私泄漏（成员推理脆弱性）并无关联，隐私泄漏主要取决于分类头的容量和训练时长，而擦除人口统计学信息虽然无法减少泄漏，却能降低年龄相关的漏诊差距。
en_tdlr: This study shows that demographic encoding in chest X-ray foundation models is not associated with privacy leakage (membership-inference vulnerability), which instead depends on head capacity and training length, while erasing demographic information reduces age-related underdiagnosis gaps without affecting leakage.
